body.summary: Advanced the execution-environment frontier from catalog presence to physical evidence. Forty-two surfaces were evaluated: 36 healthy, three credential-degraded, one unavailable Java stub, and two intentionally unselected dotenv shadows. Repaired the existing Restate venv’s broken pip installation, added durable ResourceGraph/ResourceWeather evidence and architecture, exercised explicit C++ frontends, and performed authenticated read-only OpenAI/AWS probes without secrets or external writes.
